proposed_mechanics_need_gameplay_program.B1: Ledger shows each planet's buy-low/sell-high trend arrow and marks the best route partner; also route setup warns when a route's margin is below upkeep (net loss). Changes a decision, not a number.
proposed_mechanics_need_gameplay_program.B3: Wire skill_B3_margin: sell prices on routes +8% (or ledger-flagged goods). Needed so the screen number is true.
proposed_mechanics_need_gameplay_program.B4: Forecast also names the planet and commodity, and the player can prepay to move one ship away; gives a decision, not a notice.
proposed_mechanics_need_gameplay_program.C2: Beacon reveals the base prices of the unpermitted system's planets, and permit is 1 expansion point cheaper once surveyed; turns scouting into a purchase choice.
